deviations: Exploratory slice, not pre-registered (Addendum B, written after the pilots): the calm policy (degraded after 0.25 s, land after 1.0 s) on iid_30 and burst_10_0.5s (both dropouts and message modes, 50 seeds, 400 runs). Reason: the default 0.30 s lost-link rule landed drones on iid_30 and burst presets and the field was never finished, because a landed drone that keeps sharing is never declared lost. It is reported separately after the pre-registered grid.

limits: Simulated only: no drone or radio hardware was used.
Link loss patterns are synthetic (named presets in sim/missions/presets.py), never measured.

Simulated only: no drone was flown and no radio was measured.
Link loss patterns are synthetic (independent or two-state bursts on a 10 ms grid) and blackouts are scripted.
Vehicle and radio parameters are literature-derived, not measured.
Simulated only: the camera footprint is a 2 m radius disc scored on a 1 m grid at fixed altitude.
Each survivor re-plans on its own belief; no consensus step between survivors.
Lost-peer declaration is a 2.0 s silence rule; a declared peer is never reinstated.
A drone that lands on its own failsafe keeps sharing, so its peers never declare it lost and its strip is not re-planned; on lossy links completion then measures the failsafe, not coverage sharing.
duplicated_fraction counts cells seen by two or more different drones (contract definition); one drone's own repeat passes do not count.
notes: Mission changes before any full run: a drone that is landing or landed covers no cells; a drone that lands on its own failsafe keeps sharing and is never declared lost, so on lossy links P(complete) measures the failsafe (see the mission limits); duplicated_fraction counts cells seen by two or more different drones (contract definition).

prediction.prediction_source: pre-registered before the runs (EXP-031 section of the private pre-registration)
prediction.text: without dropout, loss changes nothing (each drone sweeps its own strip). With a dropout and delta messages, loss makes survivors believe covered cells are uncovered, so duplication rises roughly with the loss rate (iid_30: about 30 % of the dead drone's reported cells unknown, duplicated); cumulative messages remove almost all of it (any single message carries the whole map). Bursts hurt delta most. Completion time with dropout: the dead drone's remaining two thirds of a strip (about 177 m^2) shared by two survivors adds about 177/(2 x 4 x 2) = 11 s plus transit, so about 45 to 55 s.
